verses.original: בֶּן־ שְׁתֵּ֨ים עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֥ם אִמּ֖וֹ חֶפְצִי־ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ben- šə·têm ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh mə·naš·šeh ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw wa·ḥă·miš·šîm wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw ḥep̄·ṣî- ḇāh
verses.literal: Manasseh was twelve . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five . . . years His mother’s name was Hephzibah
verses.literalPt: TINHA Manassés doze anos de idade quando começou a reinar, e cinqüenta e cinco anos reinou em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Hefzibá.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּתֽוֹעֲבֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇōṯ hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer hō·w·rîš Yah·weh mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD by following the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, conforme as abominações dos gentios que o SENHOR expulsara de suas possessões, de diante dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיָּ֗שָׁב וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ אֶת־ הַבָּמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִבַּ֖ד חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֑יו וַיָּ֨קֶם מִזְבְּחֹ֜ת לַבַּ֗עַל וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אֲשֵׁרָה֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה אַחְאָב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּשְׁתַּ֙חוּ֙ לְכָל־ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ד אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- hab·bā·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer ’ib·baḏ ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ’ā·ḇîw way·yā·qem miz·bə·ḥōṯ lab·ba·‘al way·ya·‘aś ’ă·šê·rāh ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ’aḥ·’āḇ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl way·yiš·ta·ḥū lə·ḵāl ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·ma·yim way·ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: For he rebuilt . . . the high places that his father Hezekiah had destroyed and he raised up altars for Baal He made an Asherah pole as King Ahab of Israel had done and he worshiped and served all the host of heaven
verses.literalPt: Porque tornou a edificar os altos que Ezequias, seu pai, tinha destruído, e levantou altares a Baal, e fez um bosque como o que fizera Acabe, rei de Israel, e se inclinou diante de todo o exército dos céus, e os serviu.

verses.original: וּבָנָ֥ה מִזְבְּחֹ֖ת בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אָשִׂ֥ים אֶת־ שְׁמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·nāh miz·bə·ḥōṯ bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer ’ā·mar Yah·weh bî·rū·šā·lim ’ā·śîm ’eṯ- šə·mî
verses.literal: Manasseh also built altars in the house of the LORD of which the LORD had said In Jerusalem I will put My Name
verses.literalPt: E edificou altares na casa do SENHOR, da qual o SENHOR tinha falado: Em Jerusalém porei o meu nome.

verses.original: וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לְכָל־ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בִּשְׁתֵּ֖י חַצְר֥וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ lə·ḵāl ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·mā·yim biš·tê ḥaṣ·rō·wṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: In both courtyards of the house of the LORD he built altars to all the host of heaven
verses.literalPt: Também edificou altares a todo o exército dos céus em ambos os átrios da casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהֶעֱבִ֤יר אֶת־ בְּנוֹ֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְעוֹנֵ֣ן וְנִחֵ֔שׁ וְעָ֥שָׂה א֖וֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִ֑ים הִרְבָּ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְהַכְעִֽיס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ĕ·ḇîr ’eṯ- bə·nōw bā·’êš wə·‘ō·w·nên wə·ni·ḥêš wə·‘ā·śāh ’ō·wḇ wə·yid·də·‘ō·nîm hir·bāh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lə·haḵ·‘îs
verses.literal: He sacrificed his own son in the fire practiced sorcery and divination and consulted mediums and spiritists He did great evil in the sight of the LORD provoking Him to anger
verses.literalPt: E até fez passar a seu filho pelo fogo, adivinhava pelas nuvens, era agoureiro e ordenou adivinhos e feiticeiros; e prosseguiu em fazer o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, para o provocar à ira.

verses.original: וַיָּ֕שֶׂם אֶת־ פֶּ֥סֶל הָאֲשֵׁרָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה בַּבַּ֗יִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ דָּוִד֙ וְאֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֔וֹ בַּבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֜ה וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּחַ֙רְתִּי֙ מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָשִׂ֥ים אֶת־ שְׁמִ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ’eṯ- pe·sel hā·’ă·šê·rāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh bab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’el- dā·wiḏ wə·’el- šə·lō·mōh ḇə·nōw bab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim ’ă·šer bā·ḥar·tî mik·kōl šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·śîm ’eṯ- šə·mî lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Manasseh even took the carved Asherah pole he had made and set it up in the temple of which the LORD had said to David . . . and his son Solomon In this temple and in Jerusalem which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel I will establish My Name forever
verses.literalPt: Também pôs uma imagem de escultura, do bosque que tinha feito, na casa de que o SENHOR dissera a Davi e a Salomão, seu filho: Nesta casa e em Jerusalém, que escolhi de todas as tribos de Israel, porei o meu nome para sempre;

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א אֹסִ֗יף לְהָנִיד֙ רֶ֣גֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַֽאֲבוֹתָ֑ם רַ֣ק׀ אִם־ יִשְׁמְר֣וּ לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ים וּלְכָל־ הַ֨תּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם עַבְדִּ֥י מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ’ō·sîp̄ lə·hā·nîḏ re·ḡel yiś·rā·’êl min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām raq ’im- yiš·mə·rū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯîm ū·lə·ḵāl- hat·tō·w·rāh ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh ’ō·ṯām ‘aḇ·dî mō·šeh
verses.literal: I will never again cause the feet of the Israelites to wander from the land that I gave to their fathers if only they are careful to do all I have commanded them the whole Law that My servant Moses commanded them
verses.literalPt: E não mais farei mover o pé de Israel desta terra que tenho dado a seus pais; contanto que somente tenham cuidado de fazer conforme tudo o que lhes tenho ordenado, e conforme toda a lei que Moisés, meu servo, lhes ordenou.

verses.original: וְלֹ֖א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ וַיַּתְעֵ֤ם מְנַשֶּׁה֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֶת־ הָרָ֔ע מִן־ הַ֨גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הִשְׁמִ֣יד יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō šā·mê·‘ū way·yaṯ·‘êm mə·naš·šeh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- hā·rā‘ min- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer hiš·mîḏ Yah·weh mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But the people did not listen and Manasseh led them astray so that they did greater evil than the nations that the LORD had destroyed before the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém não ouviram; porque Manassés de tal modo os fez errar, que fizeram pior do que as nações, que o SENHOR tinha destruído de diante dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־ עֲבָדָ֥יו הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw han·nə·ḇî·’îm lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD spoke through His servants the prophets saying
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR falou pelo ministério de seus servos, os profetas, dizendo:

verses.original: יַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ הַתֹּעֵב֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה הֵרַ֕ע מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֥וּ הָאֱמֹרִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְפָנָ֑יו וַיַּחֲטִ֥א גַֽם־ אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּגִלּוּלָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh mə·naš·šeh me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh hat·tō·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh hê·ra‘ mik·kōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śū hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer lə·p̄ā·nāw way·ya·ḥă·ṭi ḡam- ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh bə·ḡil·lū·lāw
verses.literal: Since Manasseh king of Judah has committed all these abominations acting more wickedly than the Amorites who preceded him and with his idols has caused Judah to sin
verses.literalPt: Porquanto Manassés, rei de Judá, fez estas abominações, fazendo pior do que tudo quanto fizeram os amorreus, que foram antes dele, e até também a Judá fez pecar com os seus ídolos;

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִי֙ מֵבִ֣יא רָעָ֔ה עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וִֽיהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ כָּל־ שֹׁמְעָיו תִּצַּ֖לְנָה שְׁתֵּ֥י אָזְנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hin·nî mê·ḇî rā·‘āh ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim wî·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer kāl- šō·mə·ʿå̄w tiṣ·ṣal·nāh šə·tê ’ā·zə·nāw
verses.literal: this is what the LORD the God of Israel says Behold I am bringing such calamity upon Jerusalem and Judah that the news will reverberate in the ears of all who hear it
verses.literalPt: Por isso, assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Eis que hei de trazer um mal sobre Jerusalém e Judá, que qualquer que ouvir, lhe ficarão retinindo ambos os ouvidos.

verses.original: וְנָטִ֣יתִי עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֵ֚ת קָ֣ו שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וְאֶת־ מִשְׁקֹ֖לֶת בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וּמָחִ֨יתִי אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־ יִמְחֶ֤ה אֶת־ הַצַּלַּ֙חַת֙ מָחָ֔ה וְהָפַ֖ךְ עַל־ פָּנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṭî·ṯî ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim ’êṯ qāw šō·mə·rō·wn wə·’eṯ- miš·qō·leṯ bêṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ ū·mā·ḥî·ṯî ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim ka·’ă·šer- yim·ḥeh ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣal·la·ḥaṯ mā·ḥāh wə·hā·p̄aḵ ‘al- pā·ne·hā
verses.literal: I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measuring line used against Samaria and the plumb line used against the house of Ahab and I will wipe out Jerusalem as one wipes out a bowl wiping it and turning it upside down
verses.literalPt: E estenderei sobre Jerusalém o cordel de Samaria e o prumo da casa de Acabe; e limparei a Jerusalém, como quem limpa o prato, limpa-o e vira-o para baixo.

verses.original: וְנָטַשְׁתִּ֗י אֵ֚ת שְׁאֵרִ֣ית נַחֲלָתִ֔י וּנְתַתִּ֖ים בְּיַ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָי֥וּ לְבַ֛ז וְלִמְשִׁסָּ֖ה לְכָל־ אֹיְבֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṭaš·tî ’êṯ šə·’ê·rîṯ na·ḥă·lā·ṯî ū·nə·ṯat·tîm bə·yaḏ ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem wə·hā·yū lə·ḇaz wə·lim·šis·sāh lə·ḵāl ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem
verses.literal: So I will forsake the remnant of My inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies And they will become plunder and spoil to all their enemies
verses.literalPt: E desampararei os restantes da minha herança, entregá-los-ei na mão de seus inimigos; e servirão de presa e despojo para todos os seus inimigos;

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֤וּ אֶת־ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י וַיִּהְי֥וּ מַכְעִסִ֖ים אֹתִ֑י מִן־ הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֤וּ אֲבוֹתָם֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū ’eṯ- hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nay way·yih·yū maḵ·‘i·sîm ’ō·ṯî min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer yā·ṣə·’ū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām mim·miṣ·ra·yim wə·‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: because they have done evil in My sight . . . and have provoked Me to anger from the day their fathers came out of Egypt until this day
verses.literalPt: Porquanto fizeram o que era mau aos meus olhos e me provocaram à ira, desde o dia em que seus pais saíram do Egito até hoje.

verses.original: וְגַם֩ דָּ֨ם נָקִ֜י שָׁפַ֤ךְ מְנַשֶּׁה֙ הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֔ד עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־ מִלֵּ֥א אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם פֶּ֣ה לָפֶ֑ה לְבַ֤ד מֵֽחַטָּאתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱטִ֣יא אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam dām nā·qî šā·p̄aḵ mə·naš·šeh har·bêh mə·’ōḏ ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- mil·lê ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim peh lā·p̄eh lə·ḇaḏ mê·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Moreover Manasseh shed so much . . . innocent blood that he filled Jerusalem from end to end . . . in addition to the sin that he had caused Judah to commit doing evil in the sight of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Além disso, também Manassés derramou muitíssimo sangue inocente, até que encheu a Jerusalém de um ao outro extremo, afora o seu pecado, com que fez Judá pecar, fazendo o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י מְנַשֶּׁה֙ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְחַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê mə·naš·šeh wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Manasseh along with all his accomplishments . . . and the sin that he committed are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao mais dos feitos de Manassés, e a tudo quanto fez, e ao seu pecado, que praticou, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב מְנַשֶּׁה֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּגַן־ בֵּית֖וֹ בְּגַן־ עֻזָּ֑א וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ mə·naš·šeh ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·ḡan- bê·ṯōw bə·ḡan- ‘uz·zā way·yim·lōḵ ’ā·mō·wn bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Manasseh rested with his fathers and was buried in his palace garden the garden of Uzza And his son Amon reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E Manassés dormiu com seus pais, e foi sepultado no jardim da sua casa, no jardim de Uzá; e Amom, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וּשְׁתַּ֤יִם שָׁנָה֙ אָמ֣וֹן בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁתַּ֣יִם שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ מְשֻׁלֶּ֥מֶת בַּת־ חָר֖וּץ מִן־ יָטְבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nāh ’ā·mō·wn bə·mā·lə·ḵōw ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nîm mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw mə·šul·le·meṯ baṯ- ḥā·rūṣ min- yā·ṭə·ḇāh
verses.literal: Amon was twenty-two . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem two years His mother’s name was Meshullemeth daughter of Haruz she was from Jotbah
verses.literalPt: Tinha Amom vinte e dois anos de idade quando começou a reinar, e dois anos reinou em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Mesulemete, filha de Harus, de Jotbá.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh mə·naš·šeh ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD as his father Manasseh had done
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, como fizera Manassés, seu pai.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּכָל־ הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־ הָלַ֣ךְ אָבִ֑יו וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֗ד אֶת־ הַגִּלֻּלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָבַ֣ד אָבִ֔יו וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ bə·ḵāl had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer- hā·laḵ ’ā·ḇîw way·ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- hag·gil·lu·lîm ’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇaḏ ’ā·ḇîw way·yiš·ta·ḥū lā·hem
verses.literal: He walked in all the ways of his father and he served and worshiped the idols his father had served
verses.literalPt: Porque andou em todo o caminho em que andara seu pai; e serviu os ídolos, a que seu pai tinha servido, e se inclinou diante deles.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲזֹ֕ב אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א הָלַ֖ךְ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw wə·lō hā·laḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ Yah·weh
verses.literal: He abandoned the LORD the God of his fathers and did not walk in the way of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim deixou ao SENHOR Deus de seus pais, e não andou no caminho do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּקְשְׁר֥וּ עַבְדֵֽי־ אָמ֖וֹן עָלָ֑יו וַיָּמִ֥יתוּ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·šə·rū ‘aḇ·ḏê- ’ā·mō·wn ‘ā·lāw way·yā·mî·ṯū ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ bə·ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then the servants of Amon conspired against him and killed the king in his palace
verses.literalPt: E os servos de Amom conspiraram contra ele, e mataram o rei em sua casa.

verses.original: וַיַּךְ֙ עַם־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַקֹּשְׁרִ֖ים עַל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָמ֑וֹן וַיַּמְלִ֧יכוּ עַם־ הָאָ֛רֶץ אֶת־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ ’êṯ kāl- haq·qō·šə·rîm ‘al- ham·me·leḵ ’ā·mō·wn way·yam·lî·ḵū ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- yō·šî·yā·hū ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon and they made his son Josiah king . . . . . . in his place
verses.literalPt: Porém o povo da terra feriu a todos os que conspiraram contra o rei Amom; e o povo da terra pôs Josias, seu filho, rei em seu lugar.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אָמ֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê ’ā·mō·wn ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Amon along with his accomplishments . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao mais dos atos de Amom, que fez, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֥ר אֹת֛וֹ בִּקְבֻרָת֖וֹ בְּגַן־ עֻזָּ֑א וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bōr ’ō·ṯōw biq·ḇu·rā·ṯōw bə·ḡan- ‘uz·zā way·yim·lōḵ yō·šî·yā·hū ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And he was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza and his son Josiah reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E o sepultaram na sua sepultura, no jardim de Uzá; e Josias, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
